```{r}
#| include: false
pkgload::load_all(Sys.getenv("APATABLES_PKG_ROOT"), quiet = TRUE)
op <- options(contrasts = c("contr.helmert", "contr.poly"))
lm_output <- lm(libido ~ dose, data = viagra)
aov_tbl <- apa.aov.table(lm_output, table.number = 4)
options(op)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-aov
#| tbl-cap: "ANOVA Results for Libido"
#| apa-note: "SS = Sum of squares. df = degrees of freedom. MS = mean square."
apa.quarto.pdf(aov_tbl)
```
